# Independent footnotes on a third website page

The Constitution appears as a new footnote on this page even though it was already cited on the website home page.^[See [@brasil1988]{.bibentry}]

A second citation on this same page reuses the local constitutional footnote.^[See [@brasil1988]{.bibentry}]

José Afonso da Silva can also reappear here as a new local footnote for this page.^[See [@silva2026]{.bibentry}]

This demonstrates the intended HTML website behavior: **reuse within one rendered page, repetition across different rendered pages**.
